item.description: Notifications, hints and tips about Asteria usage and features will appear here. Check back regularly or enable RSS in the app settings.

item.title: AI Model Providers - Important Update
item.description: AI providers and their pricing change frequently. Mistral AI is now a paid service and no longer offers free API keys. Google Gemini may experience heavy load and return temporary errors during peak times. For reliable, free testing, we recommend Groq (https://groq.com/) - it works flawlessly and is free. Configure your provider in Settings → Configure AI Models.
